build_PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator: build a PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator instance for a given dataset name like voc_2007_test
run_PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator_evaluate: run the evaluate method on a PascalVOCDetectionEvaluator to compute mAP, AP50, and AP75
run_voc_eval: run voc_eval to compute recall, precision, and AP for a single class against ground truth annotations
run_voc_ap: run voc_ap to compute average precision from precision and recall arrays using VOC07 or VOC12 metric
run_parse_rec: run parse_rec to parse a PASCAL VOC XML annotation file into a list of object dictionaries
